title: A cost efficient protocol to introduce epitope tags by CRISPR-Cas9 mediated gene knock-in with asymmetric semi-double stranded template
author: Fang, Shinkai
materials: 1.2 Prepare of sgRNA expression Cas9 vector (pL-CRISPR.EFS.tRFP, Addgene #57819) using BsmBI-v2 (NEB #R0739) digestion following the manufacturer's protocol (please see note). After electrophoresis (0.8% agarose), purify the digested vector using a gel extraction kit. The digested vector can be store at −20 °C for at least a year.

steps.title: Design and order sgRNA oligos
steps.instruction: Order the two sgRNA oligonucleotides (100 µM in TE) so that the Cas9 cut site (3–4 nt upstream of the PAM) lies within a 10‑bp window of the intended epitope‑tag insertion site.

steps.title: Prepare sgRNA expression vector
steps.instruction: Digest the pL‑CRISPR.EFS.tRFP plasmid (Addgene #57819) with BsmBI‑v2 (NEB #R0739) following the manufacturer’s protocol (extend digestion to 2 h if using BsmBI #R0580). Run the reaction on a 0.8 % agarose gel, excise the linearized band, and purify it with a gel‑extraction kit. Elute 1 µg of plasmid in 50 µL. Store the linearized vector at –20 °C (stable for ≥1 year).

steps.title: Anneal sgRNA oligos and dilute
steps.instruction: Mix 10 µL (100 µM) of each sgRNA strand (total 20 µL) and anneal: 95 °C for 5 min; ramp down to 85 °C at 0.1 °C/s, hold 30 s; ramp down to 25 °C at 0.1 °C/s. Dilute 5 µL of the annealed duplex into 195 µL ddH₂O (final volume 200 µL). This diluted sgRNA duplex will be used for ligation.

steps.title: Ligate sgRNA insert into vector
steps.instruction: Combine 0.5 µL linearized vector with 2 µL of the diluted sgRNA duplex. Add Takara Ligation Mix (catalog #6023) and incubate according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Transform and plate ligation product
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL chemically competent Mach1 or DH5α cells directly to the ligation mixture, mix, incubate on ice 5 min, heat‑shock at 42 °C for 1 min, return to ice 1 min. Plate on Ampicillin‑supplemented LB agar (100 µg/mL) and incubate overnight at 37 °C. Include a negative control using the empty linearized vector.

steps.title: Sequence cloned sgRNA construct
steps.instruction: Pick 2–4 colonies, perform a mini‑prep, and send the DNA for Sanger sequencing using the human U6 forward primer (or an appropriate primer if a different backbone is used).

steps.title: Transfect cells with sgRNA‑Cas9 plasmid
steps.instruction: Seed 0.5 × 10⁶ HeLa cells (ATCC CCL‑2) in a 6 cm dish with DMEM one day prior. For each dish, prepare a transfection mix containing 2 µg sgRNA‑Cas9 plasmid, 8 µL PEI (Polysciences #24765‑2, 1 mg/mL), and 100 µL Opti‑MEM (Thermo Fisher #31985070). Mix, incubate at room temperature 5 min, add evenly to the cells, and replace medium the next day. Aim for ~70 % confluence at transfection; adjust reagent or use alternatives for PEI‑sensitive lines.

steps.title: Validate sgRNA activity by genomic PCR
steps.instruction: At 48 h post‑transfection, detach cells with trypsin and extract crude genomic DNA using the Guide‑it Mutation Detection Kit (Clontech #631448) with the following modification: for 1–2 × 10⁵ cells use 36 µL Buffer I and 4 µL Buffer II. Lyse, centrifuge at 10 000 g, 4 °C for 10 min, and collect 20 µL supernatant. Dilute this 1:5 in ddH₂O. Perform PCR and heteroduplex (T7 endonuclease or Guide‑it Resolvase) digestion as per the kit instructions. Store the diluted DNA at –20 °C (stable for ≥1 year).

steps.title: Optional tail‑lysis DNA preparation
steps.instruction: For 1–2 × 10⁵ cells, add 50 µL Buffer I (25 mM NaOH, 2 mM EDTA, pH 8.0) to the pellet, incubate at 95 °C for 15 min, then neutralize with an equal volume of Buffer II (40 mM Tris, pH 5.5). Use the lysate directly for PCR.

steps.title: Assess cleavage by gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the PCR products on an agarose gel and visualize heteroduplex digestion fragments. A successful sgRNA yields clear additional bands indicating cleavage.
